evals.name: infers-repository-convention-before-writing
evals.expected_output: Reads the repository's project instructions and existing work-artifact convention first. If none exists, recommends the neutral .work base. It presents one repository-relative artifact-base proposal and the exact instruction-file edit, writing nothing until the user accepts.
expectations: Reads project instruction files before proposing a value
Preserves an existing declared repository convention instead of guessing
Recommends .work when the repository declares no convention
Writes nothing until the user accepts the value

evals.name: rejects-nonportable-paths
evals.expected_output: Rejects the absolute machine-local path with a visible explanation, makes no file changes, and requests a repository-relative base whose normalized destination remains under the repository root.
expectations: Makes no file changes for an invalid path
Does not write pluginConfigs, personal settings, or plugin files

evals.name: writes-shared-project-instruction-idempotently
evals.expected_output: After confirmation, records .work in the repository's existing work-artifact instruction surface or creates .claude/rules/work-artifacts.md. It preserves unrelated content, verifies the file is tracked, and an immediate re-run proposes no equivalent rewrite.
expectations: Persists the convention in a team-shared project instruction file
Creates .claude/rules/work-artifacts.md only when no existing instruction surface owns the convention
Preserves unrelated content and verifies the instruction file is not gitignored
Re-running does not rewrite an equivalent convention
